There is a surf club there and the beach is patrolled by surf lifesavers as well as lifeguards. The waves are generally well formed here and the beach is great for people of all ages. Bluebottles can be a hazard here from time to time, but I've only been stung here once in all the years that I have come here. There are plenty of cafes and take away places around here. Be careful if you decide to get hot chips as the seagulls are very aggressive and will happily snatch food from right out of your hand!

reviews.title: Beautiful place in the pacific
reviews.text: It was very nice to see all the surfers in Manly beach. It was like in the movies! Also there is a nice walk to other beach. Locals are very easygoing and they would tell you more about the curiosity about the place if you talk to them

reviews.title: A fun little beach town
reviews.text: Visited with the family. It’s nice to see how Sydneysiders cut loose. Nice high street between ferry and the beach.

reviews.title: Quite impressive
reviews.text: Even if you are not a swimmer, you will enjoy seeing Manly Beach.  Today we watched as dozens of children were taking surfing lessons, we walked along the beach to Shelly Beach and came back to do more people watching and sight seeing along the beach.  It is a beautiful site and there is lots of room to accomodate even those like us, who do not dare tackle the waves.To get to the beach, ride the ferry to Manly and then walk straight up the pedestrian walkway (ask for directions at the Info Centre if needed).  The beach is right there within 5 mins of the ferry terminal.  You will shuckle as you see the many youth walking around with their surf boards.The beach is lovely and is surrounded by all sorts of eating establishments.  A great way to spend a summer day in Sydney

reviews.title: Great place to surf (or even to just watch)
reviews.text: A popular place yet the beach is so long that it's never crowded. Just chill out wandering along the promenade watching those of a more energetic nature out in the surf. Pretty There's not just the beach though, the town area is pretty with lots of little coffee outlets too. Use the Manly Fast Ferry from Circular Quay to get there in around 20mins or use the Captain Cook HOHO Ferry for a more leisurely trip which visits a couple of places on the way yet still only takes 40-45mins.

reviews.title: Beach heaven
reviews.text: If you like the beech this is the place to come too manly has an old feel to it but modern excellent walks along the front loads of cafes and restaurants only wish we had more time to enjoy

reviews.title: Very crowded
reviews.text: The ferry trip from Circular Quay is always lovely and a great way to see some of the harbour, but the crowds on a Sunday can be huge. It's difficult to get into a restaurant and it certainly isn't one of Sydney's best beaches, but it is worth a visit if you are in Sydney and have a few hours to spare.

reviews.title: Crowded and touristy
reviews.text: We visited on a Sunday so the beach was expectedly crowded. We made our way to the Shelly beach which was easy walk. The pubs and bars near the beach was not cheap but those along the manly wharf was more varied. Good experience to experience the feel of a busy beach thronged with tourists and locals

reviews.title: Best place for surfing
reviews.text: Manly has a lot to give, beaches(Manly, Shelly, Fairlight beaches are the best) Manly and Shelly beaches a bit busier then the Fairlight beach. If you like surfing and playing with waves Manly beach is the best.

reviews.title: Great beach and town
reviews.text: We had been recommended to visit Manly beach by many people and glad we made the trip. You can get fast ferries there from multiple places in Sydney and harbour for under 10$. From the ferry dock it's only 5 mins walk along a good shopping street to the beach. The beach is clean and well maintained with good facilities inc showers. It's a lovely area with lots of good restaurants along front and attractive views and walks.Forget Bondai beach this is miles better. Beaches covered by lifeguards too and hire shops for surfboards etc inc lockers at good prices.

reviews.title: Best beach in Sydney in my opinion – Manly Beach has it all!
reviews.text: Manly Beach is located in a perfect position, 1 min. walk from the Corso, 5-10 min. walk from the Wharf and a short ferry ride from Sydney CBD. The waves are great, the atmosphere is so friendly and warm – people help each other out and keep an eye out for each other's stuff at the beach. Here's everything your beach-heart could wish for. Good for families, couples and friends. Laid back feeling in the afternoon, hardcore swim-workouts in the morning. Would recommend this beach over Bondi – this is where you go to feel that relaxing and soothing beach recreation and surf fun.

reviews.title: A must see in Sydney.
reviews.text: Tame the Manly ferryfrom Circular Quay and enjoy the harbour views. Only tales 30 minutes then enjoy a walk along this majestic beach

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach I have seen
reviews.text: The beach is a surf beach, very safe for swimming or surfing, nice golden sand and picture perfect.This is a must see if your traveling from overseas.

reviews.title: Not so crowded like Bondi beach
reviews.text: Due to the missing train line is Manly beach not so packed by backpackers.It offers pretty good surf, however very crowded any time and season. Manly is pretty windy and covered showers, changing rooms and toilet are insufficient. However Manly has the right vibe and plenty shops and walks around.

reviews.title: One day tour
reviews.text: Good for one day tour. Ferry is available from Circular quay. The ferry journey is awesome. You can view Sydney opera house, harbour bridge and Opera house while you are on ferry. Food shop available in Manly area.

reviews.title: Drunken Party Area
reviews.text: Unfortunately our recent visit has seen it turn into an area of drunken yobs and depravity. There was many groups of drunken youths that appeared to have an issue with the proper use of the English language swearing at every opportunity whilst families with young children where in their vicinity. On top of this there was a lot of litter around the place. The sand and sea was good but then it is natural. The beauty of this area has been spoiled by commercialism and the clientele. Will not be visiting again.

reviews.title: Weekday Visit
reviews.text: Took the ferry from Circular Quay to Manly.  Enjoyed the walk around, dipped our toes in the water, had an awesome ice cream then fish and chips on the promenade before returning to the hotel in Sydney

reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.text: Absolutely  beautiful beaches great walks along beach front easy accesd for disabled and elderley to wander along lots of seating to rest at

reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.text: Took the ferry over and walked around the little town and visited the beautiful beach. I also ha lunch on the waterfront and had a delightful fish and chips lunch. Wellworth the visit

reviews.title: A must
reviews.text:
Hey Cloney!
Sunset drinks on the harbour at Manly Cove, and a starlight ferry ride home....What a day, and what a way to enjoy Manly! 
Much more that just a sunny beach side destination.
Next time, book a hotel and stay for the weekend! You'll fund much more to explore...

Much Manly Love

reviews.title: Take a Ferry to Manly Beach and Corso
reviews.text:
Hey Scott!
Sure is easier! Ferries galore - take you door to door from Circular Quay to Manly. What a way to ride!

Our super funky markets run every Saturday and Sunday (unless it's raining or super windy), just off The Corso.

Add in 150 bars and restaurants, plus 200 stores to explore.... 40 different walks, beaches and activities, and you've discovered our own little piece of paradise!

See you again (we hope).

Much Manly Love!

reviews.title: Great little excursion
reviews.text: Taking the ferry to Manly Beach is an inexpensive side trip that won’t disappoint.  While giving you an opportunity to experience a Sydney Harbour Ferry, there are plenty of things to do in Manly Beach.  Surf, bodyboard, soak in the sun, eat, drink, shop, etc.  Souvenir t-shirt shops seem to be less expensive than other areas too.

reviews.title: It may have been a dull day weatherwise But......
reviews.text: Well worth the 30 minutes journey by ferry from circular quay, and then to find that it was a 5 minute direct stroll from the port to the beach, no one could lost trust me  just walk off the ferry and continue walking in a straight line. You pass some wonderful little shops, but remember to look up at the architecture of some of the buildings it is not to be missed.

reviews.title: One of my favorite beaches!
reviews.text: Take an easy ferry ride from Circular Quay to Manly and you will experiences one of the best beaches in the world. A pedestrian walkway, lined w/ shops and restaurants, takes you from the Manley ferry docks right to the beach, and you can walk along the beach or the boardwalk. The sun is intense (November) so plan accordingly. Water fountains along the path let you fill your water bottle.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Use your Opel card on the public ferry to Manly Beach and shops.what a great day out.great atmosphere,stunning beach.And great to walk along.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: While it does not have the whaouh factor bondi beach gives, it is a lovely spot, somehow less busy.The surrounding area offers cool shopping and drinking spot.I found the ferry ride from circular quay so amazing that I would  recommend, if only for the boat!

reviews.title: Lovely Area
reviews.text: This area of Sydney is great, the walk along the beach is a must for any visitor that wants to enjoy the beach and the views. After a lovely walk there are so many lovely cafes to choose from. The ferry trip over is also a great way to take in the sites of the harbour.

reviews.title: 1st experience in Sydney
reviews.text: After a few missteps on obtaining our ferry ticket 🤦🏻‍♂️, we made it Manly Beach. Weather was awesome and caught a sunset in the way back. Definitely hit up The Fish Shack and Yogurtland on the way back if staying on the mainland. Great spot to enjoy food on the beach and chill. Also has a cool walking path along the Pacific Ocean

reviews.title: Relax place
reviews.text: 30 mins boat from Circular Quay. Amazing n beautiful beach. Many shop around with bar and food restaurants. Cool worth to go .

reviews.title: Great day in Manly
reviews.text: Lovely little gem!  We ate lunch at Bonita Chica and enjoyed a hike at the Headlands.  Don’t miss it!  The Manly Beach is lovely.

reviews.title: Well worth a visit
reviews.text: This is a beautiful long beach. Not as pretty as Bondi but still worth a visit. It does however have the advantage of having sun loungers to rent.Note Manly beach is not the one by the wharf but a short walk through the centre which is lined with shops and cafes.

reviews.title: Good day outing!
reviews.text: We took the boat out and enjoyed the scenery. Walked along the front. There are plenty places to have a coffee or a drink. The beach has good facilities

reviews.title: Not to be missed
reviews.text: If want to get away from the crowds in Sydney jump on a fast ferry and 20 minutes later you’re in the beautiful manly. Fantastic walks with breathtaking views. All with a very relaxing atmosphere.. walk to cabbage tree bay about 30 minutes walk from the centre and you’ll see the blue water dragons lazing in the sun on the rocks.. plenty of little cafes and bars.. if I could give this place more stars I would..

reviews.title: nice beach
reviews.text: can have a fun day at this stop, have a lot of cafes near by and barbeque facility. washrrom and toilets as well

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: We took the ferry to Manly. It was a Sunday so there were many people there. There are plenty of life guards around so it's very safe. when we went the water was super cold though.

reviews.title: Free WiFi on the beach
reviews.text: We love coming here to get away from the hustle and bustle elsewhere in Sydney. We love to chill out on the beach and watch the surfers. If you’re desperate to keep up to date with friends there’s also free WiFi available!

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Loved it! What a lovely place. Get here by ferry out of Sydney harbour. Reasonably priced, cheaper if you use opal card. 20 mins trip. Lovely 10 min walk down to main beach 🏖. Beautiful sand and rolling waves. Watch all surfers and competitions going on. Lovely walks up and down the sea front. Walk around to little beach and up onto top for cliff top walk...lovely. Great coffee shops, bars, restaurants, lots going on. Nightlife too.  Good food. Friendly and lovely atmospheres.

reviews.title: Fun atmosphere
reviews.text: After a pleasant ferry ride it is only 200 metres to the beach where lots of people having fun surfing, walking, eating, cruising. You can walk along the seafront, either way, a km or two. Plenty of places to eat, have coffee or a drink. Relatively sheltered from southerly winds which may be cool elsewhere.

reviews.title: Love Manly
reviews.text: We travel to Manly, several times a year as we love the feel of the place. Beautiful surfing beach, great cafes & shopping. We always stay at either Novotel or The Sebel & are happy with both, especially the Sebel. Easy walk to catch the ferry if you want to go over to Sydney.

reviews.title: Worth a half day trip
reviews.text: Even if I do a weekend trip to sydney I will squeeze in time to hop on the ferry to Manly Beach. The ferry ride is fabulous u get great views of the bridge and the oph for photo ops. The beach is bigger and more beautiful than bondi and plenty  of shops and markets to explore.

reviews.title: Great walk
reviews.text: Great beach not so crawdy with a lot of facilities.There is a pool further and an other beach great also where yiu can do snorkeling -> Shelly beach

reviews.title: Great Beach!  Clear water and not overcrowded
reviews.text: I love Manly Beach!  better than Bondi Beach...  more laid back.  Great weekend market.  Clean sea water and white sand :)

reviews.title: One of the Best in Sydney!
reviews.text: Take the ferry from Circular Quay and enjoy the ride to Manly Beach. Once you are there, in addition to a wonderfully huge beach, there are great places to eat and shop.

reviews.title: Oh Manly The Only!
reviews.text: Rode the SpeedFerry from Sydney to Manly Harbor and enjoyed every minute of it on the way. Manly was all welcoming the moment we stepped on the wharf, till we returned. It was a Saturday eve so the mood among tourists was livelier than usual, and the Whitney Houston’s songs blaring through loudspeakers made the already happy moods happier. Loved the walk from Harbor onto the beach, and alongside the embankment. It's almost like committing a sin if you visit Manly beach but don't try Fish & Chips. Thank god we didn't fall into sinners category. The views are stunning, stroll a blessing, environment grandeur, and the sunset just breathtaking!

reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: We ❤️ Manly.The ferry drops you off in a great location and we walked along the Corso to the beach. WOW!We could’ve stayed right there forever, not too busy at this time and there were families, couples, groups of people all doing their own thing, having a real cool time.There are some great looking pie shops and restaurants in the area we were in and the architecture was awesome, a real mixture of new and old.Love this place.

reviews.title: Take the Ferry to  Manly Beach
reviews.text: With the Ferry the trip is extremely enjoyable. Expect rough seas for the last part of the trip.Walk to the Beach and back to the terminal.

reviews.title: Very nice beach
reviews.text: A nice ferry ride to this place takes about 30mins and great view's,beach itself tidy plenty of eating places in area a veriety of prices, good clear water and well life guarded,but just like most beaches it depends what you want😎👍

reviews.title: Beautiful Beaches
reviews.text: This was my first trip to Manly. Getting across from the city was so easy and nice on the Manly ferry with beautiful views of North Head. The beaches are just beautiful. Heaps of places to swim and the beaches are well patrolled. We had a swim at Shelly Beach and Collins Flat, both were fabulous.

reviews.title: Beautiful Scenery
reviews.text: Loved the scenery and expanse of beach and shops.  Easy and inexpensive to get to by ferry--very scenic ferry ride.  Prices are better than Sydney and Bondi Beach. Ate at Guzman Y Gomez just outside of the ferry wharf--good burritos.  Happy to finally find Mexican fast food as we were yearning for some during 9 day stay in Sydney. Great walk through The Corso and see many shops, walk on the beach, watched volleyball games, had beverage at great place on the patio on way back to ferry--Manly Wharf Hotel.  And be careful of the candy kiosk in the ferry wharf--yummy goodies !!!!  ENJOY !!!!

reviews.title: Manly beach
reviews.text: Nice beach can walk around to smaller beaches . Lots of bars cafes and restaurants in the area. Easy to get to from circular Quay on the ferry.

reviews.title: Better than Bondi
reviews.text: First time visit and I really enjoyed my afternoon there.  Great character buildings in the area, plenty of places to eat. Though Bondi gets most of the attention if I was a local I'd be going to Manly.

reviews.title: Great surfing beaches
reviews.text: Very good surfing beaches, packed full of people and easier to get to than Bondi beach in my view. Life guards everywhere to keep you safe on the main beach, but there are lots of little beaches and rocky areas where you can get out to swim. Unfortunately we saw someone drowned in one of the smaller beaches but it was packed full with people so enough people around to notice something went wrong. So please stay mindful. Otherwise surrounding Manly beach there are a dozen other walkways and paths to stroll. You can spend all day here.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Manly has a selection of beaches, one for great waves if you’re a keen surfer or Shelley beach which is part of a marine reserve where it’s possible to snorkel and see the marine life below.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Manly beach is a must do as it is so easy to get to now. This was my first visit and I will definitely go back again when I am in Sydney.Fast ferry's now get you to Manly beach in only 20 mins.  When you go to Circular Quay you can either pay at the ticket office at each entrance or use your Opal card now. It only costs $9.10 one way.When you get off the ferry, it is only a walk of 5 mins straight ahead once you get off the ferry to enjoy the sand in your toes.Go for a long walk, take your shoes off  and enjoy the sand and surf. If your hungry there are shops on the beachfront too.

reviews.title: Simply beautiful & ideal for a morning run
reviews.text: For me this is the best of the big beaches in and around Sydney, granted I'm not a local but to run from Manly Creek down to Shelly Creek which is beautiful too and back is wonderful...It's busy on and off the beach itself with so many folks enjoying the great outdoors

reviews.title: Manly
reviews.text:
Hey Odyssey!
Shame - If its a sunny day, Manly sure can be popular!
The best public transport options, are the ferry's... which connect to bus and train lines throughout Sydney.
There are 4 different services running continuously all day:
The classic Manly ferry, green and gold from Circular Quay
The Manly Fast Ferry, offering the same service, but ten minutes quicker (with beers on-board all day)
The Eco Hopper, which moves around Sydney Harbour.
The Barangaroo ferry, from Darling Harbour area direct to Manly.
Sundays is all day travel on public transport for a super low, maximum fee of $2.70!!
Hope to see you again... with a smooth journey!

reviews.title: Ferry to Manley
reviews.text: Must do whilst In Sydney Buzzing mall with tourists everywhere Well worth the trip Great place Iconic beach and it’s exciting Great pubs with history Plenty of shopping for those that love the sport whilst for those who seek experience and adventurous to fill the soul this is good too Great walking opportunities

reviews.title: Decent Beach, Lots of Tourists
reviews.text: I took advantage of the low cost Sunday transport to check out Manly Beach. Lots of shops, cafes, and walks along the water.

reviews.title: A wonderful beach indeed👌😀
reviews.text: Take your picnic and relax and take in this breathtaking beach. We opted for fish and chips before walking along the headland. A wonderful day indeed.

reviews.title: Take City Manly Ferry to beach, a half or day out
reviews.text: Hop on the famous Manly Ferry and in 30 minutes you are over in Manly. A more relaxed and typical Australian seaside town, easy to reach if you have no car, and want a leisurely boat ride over.Some buskers usually around, some clever kids and remarkable skills, playing,singing what we could never do!Plenty cafes, but stay off the main shopping area from the ferry to the beach, as its a bit run down, and not much unique there. Walk to the beach in about 7 minutes from ferry, and go left or right and find a cafe or eatery along there. Less expensive than Sydney, makes a perfect half day or day out.Relaxed, and kept well, it is truly something very special when visiting Sydney.Don't worry if if it is windy, cloudy, the ferry just gets choppy and many people get drenched with salt water, and it is even more fun!

reviews.title: Wlaking
reviews.text: Early morning walks from Queenscliffe to the Bower and back. It’s a 5 km round trip and so nice in the morning

reviews.title: A beautiful day outing especially on a Sunday
reviews.text: We visited Manly Beach yesterday. It was a fabulous day. Using your Opal card, you can travel anywhere on the Sydney bus, train and ferry system for only $2.50 on a Sunday. This includes nonresidents.Manly Beach is a beautiful spot, even if the weather is cloudy. The ferry ride is about a half hour. When you exit from the ferry go to the information booth for information and a map.  This is the major tourist destination and also a residential area. There were dozens of stores, restaurants and tourist facilities. Stroll along the beach and take one of the paths up into the hills where you will be able to see some fortifications from the second world war. Try the ice cream at Royal Copenhagen near the beach (or better yet, the waffle bowl with three scoops, actual melted chocolate and unlimited almonds and sprinkles toppings at no extra charge) — enough for two. We had lunch at The Boathouse restaurant before heading up into the hills. We saw numerous arts and crafts kiosks as well as fresh fruits and organic vegetables.  A ferry leaves from cap circular Quay Every 30 minutes on the half hour and hour. Likewise at the island for the departure is every half hour.

reviews.title: different from Bondi
reviews.text: This beach and area is more peaceful then Bondi. Many shops and restaurants located in this area and around the beach. The Manly ferry from Circular Quay is awesome and a must do. we had hired a car, so drove around and all the way up the hill for even better views down to water

reviews.title: Beautiful and peaceful place
reviews.text: If you want to relax and to forget about the bustle please go to Manly beach. I like it much more than Bondi beach. Here is the atmosphere of relax and joy. Here is a very beautiful nature and peaceful people. Enjoy!

reviews.title: My Local Beach, Great Surf, Crystal Clear Water
reviews.text: Great stretch of surf beach from South Steyne to North Steyne. Beautiful and clear, great surf. Great for kids.

reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.text: Enjoyable visit, however I wouldn’t go again at the weekend, as it was extremely busy, and restaurants very full.  Totally different on the Monday, even though the weather was still perfect, it was so much quieter, I felt our day was wasted there on the Sunday.

reviews.title: The Family Friendly Beach
reviews.text: This is a family friendly beach. Swim between the flags and you are ok. Other areas for boogie and surfboard riders, Also surfboard riding school there,

reviews.title: DO NOT EAT NEAR THE BIRDS!!
reviews.text: we packed a picnic lunch and a bird LITERALLY flew up behind me and grabbed my sandwich from my hands!!...HOLY CRAP!!...Never had that happen before....They're totally aggressive!!..BE CAREFUL! Other then that...beautiful shops and beach..had a great day!!!

reviews.title: A trip to the quieter side
reviews.text: After a day in bustling Sydney, we were very relaxed riding in the ferry over to Manly Beach.  The fast ferry takes about 15 minutes.  When you arrive at Manly Beach, you find yourself immersed in a completely different world.  The small town is charming in itself.  The beach walk is absolutely gorgeous.  If you enjoy hiking, you’ll love the beach nature trail at Manly Beach.  It’s a great place for the family to visit, and there are stores where you can shop while heading down to the beach from the ferry.  They have plenty of places to eat, including fast food.

reviews.title: Nice beach, nice area, beautiful boardwalk
reviews.text: We took the ferry to visit.  Lots of shops and restaurants, and we took a beautiful stroll on the boardwalk up to Shelly beach.  Beautiful sceneries and homes as well as quiet places.  Worth the visit!

reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.text: I took the ferry from Darling harbour to Manley and spent several hours walking the beach path.  Wonderful views and well maintained footpath.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: We took a ferry over for the afternoon and picked up lunch at the beach.  Lots of places to buy food and drinks right along the street by the beach.  The ferry ride was also a nice way to see the water side of syndey.

reviews.title: So beautiful, clean and white beach.
reviews.text: take the ferry from Cirkular Quey to Manly, evary half hour, enjoy the day there either shopping or swimming.

reviews.title: Great beach with plenty to do
reviews.text: We arrived on the ferry form Sydney I’d recommend getting the faster boat lovey beach with plenty of surfing going on also plenty of shops and nice markets and sales at the weekend defo worth s venture out from Sydney

reviews.title: THE beach to go to!
reviews.text: If you have only a short period of time in the Sydney area are you a a beach goer, then I highly recommend that you head directly to Manly Beach, totally bypassing Bondi Beach.  Sure Bondi is a lot more convenient to get to but I believe that you will be rewarded for the little extra effort it takes to get to Manly.  Nicer beach, more cafes and pubs and better shopping.

reviews.title: Sydney must do !
reviews.text: This trip was arranged  by one of our Australian  friends. I am really pleased he did take us there. Manly beach is amazing  with one of the most diverse  coastal walks you could do in a short period  of time. From beach front, to rugged  protected shore line, houses  perched  on stilts above the path, little gift shops and cafes. Wonderful walk all the way to Shelly Beach.

reviews.title: Atlantic Ocean beach
reviews.text: We walked all along Manly beach front and out to Shelly beach. The waves were rolling in and there were surfers to watch. We found sun traps despite the showery weather and watched the waves and surfers and the rescue boat. The sand is so fine and both beaches were reasonably clean. We particularly liked the little sculptures in the rocks close to Shelly beach.

reviews.title: Clean sand and clear water
reviews.text: Take the ferry to Manly, as you get a beautiful view of the coast and of Sydney harbour. The beach itself is lovely, but as far as beaches go, it’s not breathtaking or anything. But still a great spot! And there’s a Ben and Jerry’s ice cream shop right on the beachfront for a cool snack. :)

reviews.title: Manly seven miles from sydney and a thousand miles from care
reviews.text: Manly is a great escape from Sydney city with beautiful beaches and a famous marine reserve at Cabbagetree Bay.  After dark the local nightlife is stifled by aggreive bouncers and ahigh police presence which combines with high drink prices and expensive accomodation.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach in Springtime
reviews.text: Walkjng along the Corso onto the beach and admiring the surf was beautiful. Admittedly, the waves were driven by the weather and swell at the time, but the sound of them crashing in and watching a few surfers  was blissful. Dont know what its like in summer, but on a cool dreary spring day it brightened our spirits and made our day.

reviews.title: Day out
reviews.text: Beautiful beach always clean. Very busy lots of locals and tourists. Nice family beach, close to shops and cafes

reviews.title: Much better than bondi
reviews.text: We went on a rainy day and it was still lovely. Longer, whiter, more organised for kids/adult activities. Well done all!

reviews.title: Aussies can be weird
reviews.text: I went to Manly because I wanted an excuse to take a ferry somewhere. It was a lovely day, so I had lunch at a restaurant with a sunny deck. Because I was the only one eating on the deck, I left a tip. The waitress took umbrage, called me names and threw the tip at me. I threw it back at her and left.

reviews.title: forest beach....
reviews.text: ultimate beach situated in mid of forest....you can walk and reach the end point ...then you see the best place ever......

reviews.title: Lovely Beach
reviews.text: Definitely worth stopping at the beach if you are in Manly. There are loads of eateries just across the road, Park equipment for the kids and footpath so you can stroll taking in the views without getting sandy feet. Nice to just sit and watch the gentle waves rolling in.

reviews.title: Sunny.
reviews.text: After several days of rain and cloud the sun finally came out so we took our chance and got the ferry over th Manly.Wasn't disappointed, long beach with lovely fine sand. Very clean beach.It's a Shame 90% of the beach is closed off to swimmers just so the surfers can have fun. Lots of eating places overlook the beach.

reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.text: Manly beach is a long stretch of beach located north of Sydney, it offer plenty of restaurants along the coast and a wonderful view over the pacific ocean where surfing is a common practice by locals and tourists. A beautiful gem in Sydney surroundings!

reviews.title: It was a nice beach and great crowd
reviews.text: Lovely beach and sunset. There was a jazz festival when we visited. I love the crowd and the view. A must visit beach in Sydney.

reviews.title: just a beach
reviews.text: nice trip there by ferry, but disappointing area....mall with so many closed shops looked rundown, rubbish all around, takeaway meals at ridiculous prices, beach closed because of dangerous currents and then blue bottles washing up, (but we know that canso, 't be helped) just a beach, and nothing special or memorable

reviews.title: Walking Tour of Manly Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful Manly Beach was an easy walk from the ferry terminal.  Enjoyed lunch on the waterfront and the walk to the protected cove.  Easy half-day trip from Sydney Harbor.

reviews.title: Beautiful setting!
reviews.text: Worth its reputation! Lovely walk on the path with lots of places to stop and take a few pictures. There’s even a pool that’s quite uniquely shaped right at the beach. You can watch people surfing, Kayaking or paddleboarding. Lots of restaurants and little stores.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in Sydney, if not the best. Its well maintained, its beautiful and and has awesome surf. Life guards patrol the beach to keep everyone safe. Stroll along the board walk around to Shelly beach. You'll also find numerous places (beach side) to grab a bite to eat or enjoy a beer. Perfect for just about anyone, including the family. Check it out if you can...

reviews.title: Wonderful Day in a Wonderful Place
reviews.text: What a lovely spot this is. A visit to Manly is a must for tourists who visit SYDNEY. Great shops, wonderful restaurants and magnificent scenery. The beaches are terrific, both the surf (ocean side) and the harbour side (for those who prefer calmer water). Beautiful walks along paved tree line streets. Public transport consists of either ferry or bus. Both drop you at Manly wharf ... ‘the gateway to Manly’. People of friendly .. a great mix of locals and tourists, both young and old. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.title: Perfect beach for a day in Sydney
reviews.text: It is definitely worth the visit. You can go there by taking the ferry from the Sydney Harbour (30 min) and then enjoy a beautiful beach, clean, with a lot of people during warm days.

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: my favorite beach in Sydney, much more family friendly than the city beaches. Very clean and pristine. Good waves on certain days but a great place to take the kids for the day. Take the ferry if you can.

reviews.title: Loved Manly Beach area
reviews.text:
Hey Dedgar2014,
We're so glad that you two enjoyed Manly beach so much.
Next time, pop into Manly Information Center outside of the Wharf for secret local hotspots.
Much love,
Manly

reviews.title: Away from the city
reviews.text: Went to this side of the city on a ferry boat, which is a fun ride itself! Beach had a jazz festival going on, Manly Jazz, huge and thrilling! Plenty bars and restaurants with many ATMs around. Beach is clean and well staffed. A lot of things to do here. Also, ferry is the best way to see Opera house from the sea! :)

reviews.title: Fantastic place to enjoy the waves
reviews.text:
Hi patrolman_pete,
You're right, Manly isn't just a beach. We're a community where all are welcome. 
We have many different cuisines and cafes, as well as breathtaking views. 
It's family-friendly and very accessible, with just a 30 minute ferry ride from the city.
Next time, go on one of our many walks to see a new side of Manly.
Much love,
Manly

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: Spent a couple of days here over a weekend it was a very nice place we stated at a hotel right across from the beach.There was a good choice of restaurants vlose by and easy to get around.It was much nicer than the heart of sydney and felt a lot more laid back and friendly

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with lots to do
reviews.text: We visited Manly Beach on a lovely spring day by ferry. The fast ferry was a joy in itself as you get to see the harbour and Manly is a vibrant little place with great bars and restaurants. The beach was clean and well staffed with lifeguards and plenty of showers and toilets. Manly is well worth a visit for those of all ages.

reviews.title: Nice place with some attractions
reviews.text: It is easy to reach Manly beach from Sydney Harbour with a boat. Manly beach is opened to the ocean but it has a smaller beach looking to the city. Between the two beaches there are shopping streets with nice shops. If you are lucky you can even see penguins (we couldn't).

reviews.title: Great place to spend a day
reviews.text: My husband and I spent the day at Manly Beach. The beach is clean and large and there is a lot of restaurants and shopping close by. I had a great time walking through the shopping area. Definitely recommend making the trip from Sydney.

reviews.title: Strong waves and lots of seagulls
reviews.text: Beach is a direct 30 minutes (approx) ferry ride from Circular Quay Wharf 3 to Manly Wharf. A smaller beach compared to Bondi Beach but the waves seem stronger (on the day I was there) which makes it good for surfing. The nearby Corso has plenty of shops, F&B options and a supermarket (Coles).

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Went here for the day - and all i would say is stay between the flags - which the life guards have put out - they are there for a reason - well, we have 3 young boys - so safety is paramount - there is enough space for everyone - nice beach - as most are

reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text:
Hey Rick,
We're proud to say Manly Beach came first in the Travelers Choice Best Beach Award.
Our beach is filled with fun activities such as swimming and volleyball 24/7. 
Manly has almost every cuisine you can think of, as well as pubs and cafes!
Visit soon!
Much love,
Manly

reviews.title: Pet friendly beach
reviews.text: This is one of the nicest beaches in Sydney. Its dog friendly while they are on leashes and everyone is just so happy and friendly. The restaurant on the beach has amazing fish and chips too.

reviews.title: Beautiful Aussie Beach
reviews.text: Some time ago I lived in the area, whether you’re a local or a visitor... this is a spectacular place.There are oodles of restaurants and bars nearby. Personally I think this place is better than Bondi. There’s plenty of shaded picnic tables for families too. There is a paved walking path between Manly and Shelley Beach... absolutely stunning and also accessible for wheelchairs. Walk is suitable for any fitness level. Would recommend catching a ferry from Circular Quay (Sydney city). The ferry is a beautiful experience in its self. Parking is extremely limited meaning it has very limited time restrictions for locals running errands or reserved for disabled parking. The ferry which back in the city is linked to the train system is so lovely, it doesn’t make sense to try and drive unless you have to.

reviews.title: Peaceful getaway from city life
reviews.text: The beach should be on your must visit list when you go to Sydney. It's half an hour away from the circular quay by ferry and song 50 mins from darling harbour by ferry. So in case you are living around these harbours, take half a day off to see the beach. There are many cafes and pubs so you won't be short of choices. There's a walkway to connect two beaches which is most used by many joggers so you can take a walk along that and enjoy the view. In case you have come in a group , there are some volleyball net setup at the beach which you can use to play.There were also many friendly cockatoos in the park along the beach so we spent the time playing with them.There are many local and branded markets along the walk to the harbour so while going or coming to beach you can enjoy that and collect some souvenirs. In all this do make sure that you return by 7pm as the last ferry to Darling harbour leaves by around 7.15pm. otherwise there are many ferrys to circular quay till 11pm and in case you are from darling harbour then  it would be around 20 min walk to Darling harbour from circular quay.

reviews.title: No sharks trust me
reviews.text:
Hey scottshlad09,
Thanks for coming to Manly.
We can assure you there's no sharks. The last fatal shark attack was in 1936.
We have many cuisines to offer as well as pubs and cafes.
Visit soon!
Much love,
Manly

reviews.title: Perfect way to spend the day
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and ferry ride.  Fun to walk the corsco and wander through the streets.  Would make it a point to encourage all travelers to check out this lovely area.  Reminded me of where I grew up...manahattan beach ca.  Their nippers are our Jr lifeguards and many many volleyball games in play.  Water was cold but many donned wetsuits and enjoyed the water

reviews.title: MUST GOT TO MANLY BEACH!
reviews.text: Manly Beach is a must go to when visiting Manly. One of the best places to visit and attraction site. Manly Beach is easily accessible with a short 30 minute Ferry ride from Sydney’s Circular Quay, followed by a casual stroll along the Manly Corso. The staff at Hello Manly Information Center recommended some cool hidden lane-ways for some healthy bites. Banana Blossom was an awesome find! I got the Tokyo Classic, which I highly recommend and close to Manly Beach. If you haven’t been to Manly beach, check it out, it’s a great destination for both locals and visitors which has great coastal vibe and beach front views!

reviews.title: Great Beaches
reviews.text: We caught the ferry from Circular Quay which takes 30 mins to get to Manly Beach. Lots of options for dining etc. There is one main street for all the usual shops and some side streets with more boutique shops. It was quite chilly on the waterfront (being springtime). We walked to the end of Manly Beach, up to Shelley Beach and then through some of the National Park to get to North Head. To be honest not a lot to see apart from shrubs but at North Head there is a cafe for food and drink and the bus back down to Manly Beach.

reviews.title: Chilling out😊
reviews.text: I've been to Manly beach several times but today is special because my granddaughter is with me, my first grandchild. Manly Beach is a tourist spot. If only I'm a surfer, I will surely love to stay here. I love their boutiques, stores, restaurants, hotels....name it😊. Friendly people most specially.

reviews.title: Average beach
reviews.text: The beach is nice enough but did not find the rest of the area to be worth the detour. There are nice cafés and restaurants and some shopping.

reviews.title: MANLY BEACH
reviews.text: You can catch the ferry from Circular Quay and admire the scenery getting there you get to see the Harbour Bridge and the Opera House. When you reach Manly Wharf there is a great little bar called Hugo's you can stop in there for a nice meal and cocktail. You can walk along the Manly promenade as you reach Manly beach. The view is breathtaking along the beach. You can walk along the beach and you can see the surfers  surfing. Manly is well known for surfing. As you walk along the promenade you come a cross a little beach called Shelly Beach that has little shops along the way and a nice little bar, You can go scuba divng on this little beach. A lot of nice little restaurants on the promenade. So many to choose from. Worth a trip.

reviews.title: What a beautiful place
reviews.text: We had heard lots of things about Manly but have never been there until today when we took the fast ferry.  What a lovely place.  You get off the ferry and take the road straight ahead of you to get to the beach.  Once you get to the beach walk along to the right and keep going until you come to Shelly Beach it is a lovely coastal walk with lots of interesting things to see and of course the big expanse of sea where there are surfers and body boarders.  You can continue on further but we stopped and turned back once we had climbed up to the top.  It is well worth a visit.

reviews.title: Many-North Head walk
reviews.text:
Hey Alexandra,
We love North Head too!
The views are extraordinary and they really help put your mind at ease.
Next time maybe try our Manly to Spit walk. It's not as elevated by definitely has some great views.
Come back soon!
Much love,
Manly

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: I would recommend taking the ferry to Manly, it is a thoroughly enjoyable trip on the water.  From the wharf you can walk up through the main strip of shops and eateries to Manly Beach at the other end.  We sat on the beach in the beautiful sunshine and enjoyed the world passing by.  There are plenty of options for dining and we found a great coffee shop.

reviews.title: Oz trip
reviews.text: great beach, easily reached by ferry from circular quay. we took the fast Manly Ferry, a 10 minute walk from the jetty down the main street gets you  to the beach. Golden sand and surf, but the water was chilly. Lots of people enjoying a sunny Sunday afternoon

reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text:
Hi Robert,
We're glad you enjoyed the ferry ride. It really is lovely, especially during sunset.
We pride ourselves on our clean and beautiful beach.
Visit soon!
Much love,
Manly

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: Hi Steve P and thank you for visiting Manly Beach, Sydney Australia. We love that you enjoyed Manly more than Bondi! Manly is beautiful with a relaxed vibe and was voted Australia's No.1 Beach on TripAdvisor earlier this year. There is always something going on with an activity for everyone. Hope to see you again soon. Much love, Manly

reviews.title: Great family beach
reviews.text: Hi Mike B and thank you so much for visiting Manly Beach, Sydney Australia. Yes! Manly Beach is a fabulous beach with a lovely relaxed vibe and it really is wonderful for kids. Shelly Beach and Little Manly Cove are sheltered beaches with no waves and perfect for kids to paddle around. Hope to see you again soon. Much love, Manly

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: Hi Pee b and thank you so much for your awesome review! So glad you loved Manly as much as we do. Did you know that Manly was voted Australia's No.1 Beach on TripAdvisor? With over 150 cafes, bars and restaurants you are spoilt for choice with something for everyone. Hope to see you again soon. Much love, Manly

reviews.title: Well known Sydney beach
reviews.text: Hi JaredYSyd and thank you for visiting Manly Beach, Sydney Australia. Yes! Manly is always buzzing with an activity for everyone and we are so glad you enjoyed your time here. Definately a wise move leaving the car behind and catching the ferry, it's a beautiful way to get here and enjoy the harbour sights on the way. Hope to see you soon. Much lovely, Manly

reviews.title: Beach and the township area
reviews.text: Hi cmotpt and thank you for visiting Manly Beach, Sydney Australia. Yes! the ferry is a fantastic way to get here and take in the harbour sights on the way. So glad you enjoyed your time in Manly, there is something for everyone and so much to do. Hope to see you again soon. Much love, Manly

reviews.title: Much to see and do, casual and upscale both
reviews.text: Manly is a relatively small and quiet suburb with its own excellent beach.  It has charming shops stores and restaurants, and most of it is nice and clean.  The area around the wharf can be a little tacky.  We have visited several times, and have occasionally seen the area overrun by partiers that were rather intoxicated and obnoxious, but this is infrequent. Late weekend nights would be the time to avoid.Restaurants run from very casual to rather upscale, just like the stores.  The Corso is a fun area to all and shop for all ages.  Unless you decide to walk up to see the Castle on the Hill at the ICMS most of the town is fairly flat and the easy to navigate.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: I took visitor from overseas, caught ferry from circular quay, it was beautiful day , bought fish and chip, ate near the beach. We walked along the shops (souvenir, chemist, take away food, ice cream, cafe etc) from the ferry wharf to the beach. there is playground for kids to play.

reviews.title: Fascinating
reviews.text:
Hi Maryam H and thank you for visiting Manly Beach, Sydney Australia!
All of your suggestions are great, there is an activity for everyone in Manly. From Shopping, hiking, swimming and surfing we have you covered!
Next time you visit why not explore North Head Sanctuary?!
Hope to see you again soon,
Much Manly Love.

reviews.title: Nice day trip from Sydney Harbour
reviews.text:
Hello RJB27540 and thank you for your review!
We totally agree that Manly is great for Day trip.
Yes! Manly is great all year round even when it is winter with plenty to do and see.
Next time try one of our scenic walks to Fairlgiht or Shelly Beach, and explore more of Manly.
Hope to see you again soon,
Much Manly love.

reviews.title: So great
reviews.text:
Hello Ladygrey606 and thanks for visiting Manly!
We love that you enjoyed Manly and came back for a second visit!
With so much to do here there is an activity for everyone.
Next time you visit why not snorkel at Cabbage Tree Bay Marine Reserve or walk North Head Sanctuary and discover more of Manly.
Hope to see you again soon,
Much Manly love.

reviews.title: A day at the Beach
reviews.text:
Hi Anthony H and and thank you for visiting Manly Beach!
we are so glad that you decide to visit us for the day on your holiday!
Yes! Manly has over 150 bars, restaurants and cafes so your spoilt for choice here.
Next time try our Manly to Spit scenic walk and explore more of what Manly has to offer.
Hope you visit again soon,
Much Manly love.
